question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Who do you think is going to be the next President?

nodes.text: Sara steps into Emily's room.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sara!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh... Uh... Hi, Sara!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hi... I just wanted to check in on you...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: When did you become Mom?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Very funny. Do you need anything? How about I order us a pizza?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What Emily meant to say was `awesome!` Thanks, Sara!
nodes.text_bbcode: What Emily meant to say was [color=#3b78e2][i]awesome![/i][/color] Thanks, Sara!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'll order it now.
As Sara closes the door, she sees Emily give Kimi a nudge...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: See?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. I stand corrected.
Later that night, Sara flops onto the couch and curls up with a pillow.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Kimi was right... I'm a one-dimensional zombie, and that makes me a nobody...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Emily loves me so much, she'll follow in my footsteps, whatever I do...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But I'm a swimmer... That's what I do... And that's what she'll do...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: In fact, that's what I'm going to do now... Might as well...
Later that night, Sara sneaks into the pool and swims laps, the water cold and uninviting...
She tries not to think about what it will mean to swim and only swim for the rest of her life...
But the more she tries, the more it becomes evident to her...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm `alone...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]alone...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Want to see a happier ending to Sara's story? Try again and see if you can score enough points to unlock it!
In the meantime, let's check out the next candidate...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Emily loves me so much, she'll follow in my footsteps, whatever I do...
The next day, Sara is heading toward Ms. Lee's temporary office when she runs into Nick.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hey, Nick! I was just going to sign up to run for President!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Taking my advice? I'm surprised considering how dumb we guys are...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Actually, my motivation came from home.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: From your dad? Isn't he kind of... Not encouraging?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: To put it mildly. It came from my younger sister.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I didn't know you had a sister...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, she's growing up, and I thought I'd try to be a better role model for her.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I guess we can add that to the list of Kessler verbs: Swimming, eating, and now, role-modeling.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hee hee! Very funny.
Nick reaches into his backpack, and pulls out a stack of glossy pictures.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I was planning on using these to convince you to run...
He hands them to her. Each one has a picture of Sara swimming, the entire image laid out perfectly.
Stylized text says, 'Vote for Sara. She's a Kessler. And that means, she cares about what she does.'

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: These are amazing!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't know if you've thought about this yet, since you've only just decided to run, but...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Do you want me to be your campaign manager?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, I like you.
Sara can't help but blush.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I mean, not like that. What I meant was...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I like you... Others will too.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Awww... I would really like it if you were my campaign manager, Nick.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: We'll be the Outsider Party.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Great! Because I just found out who else is running, and I think you'll need all the help you can get!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Wait... Who else is running?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And she's never going to have a boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Maybe you're right...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Ugh...I really wish I hadn't heard any of that...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: She's `never` had a boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: She doesn't have a boyfriend!
Sara walks away...
That night, Sara is passing by her sister's room when she hears her name... She stops, listening.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Are you kidding? Sara is `way` faster than me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you kidding? Sara is [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] faster than me.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Why are we talking about swimming?! It's like impossible to come see you and not talk about swimming `at least` once.
nodes.text_bbcode: Why are we talking about swimming?! It's like impossible to come see you and not talk about swimming [color=#3b78e2][i]at least[/i][/color] once.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What can I say? I'm a Kessler.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That sounds familiar. But I don't want to snoop... I'll give them some privacy...
Sara starts to leave, but then she hears...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So? Are you coming to Brian's party?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I... I can't. I...
Kimi drones like a zombie...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Have to practice swimming... Kesslers must swim... Dad says so...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I don't sound like that! I'm not a zombie!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Look, I'm not talking about some dumb guy's party where, like, the boys play video games on a couch and all the girls stand around looking at their dresses!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm talking about a `Brian` party! He's going to have a karaoke machine and everything! Come on, you're only going to be in 8th grade `once!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm talking about a [color=#3b78e2][i]Brian[/i][/color] party! He's going to have a karaoke machine and everything! Come on, you're only going to be in 8th grade [color=#3b78e2][i]once![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I know... But... I can't.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Listen to yourself! Does being a Kessler also mean doing `one` thing your `whole` life?! If you want to be cool, this is the chance!
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen to yourself! Does being a Kessler also mean doing [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] thing your [color=#3b78e2][i]whole[/i][/color] life?! If you want to be cool, this is the chance!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well... Sara's cool, and she only does one thing.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I hate to break it to you, Emily, but no one knows who your sister is! She's not cool!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's not true! My sister `is` cool, Kimi! You're just trying to pressure me into going to the party!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's not true! My sister [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] cool, Kimi! You're just trying to pressure me into going to the party!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Do I need to state the obvious? She's not cool, Emily, and let me tell you `exactly` why!
nodes.text_bbcode: Do I need to state the obvious? She's not cool, Emily, and let me tell you [color=#3b78e2][i]exactly[/i][/color] why!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Remember? Neither of us fit in that well... I don't think I'd get many votes.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I didn't win Homecoming Princess. I'm pretty sure I won't win the Presidency.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess I hadn't considered popularity. It's always been such a dumb thing to me anyway...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, it's nice to know that at least one person would vote for me...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Outsiders have to stick together, right?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Something like that.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That's what I do.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't understand. If you did something that wasn't swimming, then you could be `more` than just a swimmer.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't understand. If you did something that wasn't swimming, then you could be [color=#e23b3b][i]more[/i][/color] than just a swimmer.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What's wrong with being just a swimmer?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Nothing is wrong with being just a swimmer. But I think there is something wrong with being just `one` thing!
nodes.text_bbcode: Nothing is wrong with being just a swimmer. But I think there is something wrong with being just [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] thing!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: If you do one thing, you end up being... Well, kind of boring.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Great. I'm boring.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's not what I meant, Sara.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, that's how it sounded...
Sara walks past him...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's Christina.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You're lying.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What? No, I'm not...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: There you go again! Who knew that all this time, the great Sara Kessler was a liar?
Sara can feel her face turning red.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: How did you know who I was?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Come on! What other girl at this school would be swimming all by herself?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: They call you `The Machine` for a reason.
nodes.text_bbcode: They call you [color=#e23b3b][i]The Machine[/i][/color] for a reason.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: What I want to know is why you gave me the wrong name...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: My guess is that you were so stunned by my good looks, you just forgot it.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No... You're a creep, that's why.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Aww, you'll come to like me.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: How about `Not Interested?` How's that for a name? Or `Annoyed?`
nodes.text_bbcode: How about [color=#3b78e2][i]Not Interested?[/i][/color] How's that for a name? Or [color=#3b78e2][i]Annoyed?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Or `Go Away Because I Don't Have The Time Or The Patience For An Ego Like Yours?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Or [color=#3b78e2][i]Go Away Because I Don't Have The Time Or The Patience For An Ego Like Yours?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: That last one's kinda long, so I think I'll just call you Sara.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Why are you asking my name when you already know it?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I just wanted to gauge how Sara `The Machine` Kessler felt about me...
nodes.text_bbcode: I just wanted to gauge how Sara [color=#e23b3b][i]The Machine[/i][/color] Kessler felt about me...

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I think you got a pretty accurate gauge.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: That I did.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So before you sign up, ask yourself... Why should `I` run?
nodes.text_bbcode: So before you sign up, ask yourself... Why should [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] run?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Who has time to be President?
After class, Sara is wrapping up the final laps of swim practice when her father calls to her from the edge of the pool...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Hey, Sara! I'm going to pick up your sister from school! No slacking while I'm gone!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I wouldn't dream of it... Heaven forbid I ease up for a second. Then I might seem mortal.
Sara keeps swimming, flashing an almost imperceptible thumbs-up sign as her hand exits the water... The signal her father trained her to give for just this scenario.
A few seconds later, she touches the far wall and swims back. Then, she sees something splash into the water ahead of her!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Dad?!
She stops and takes off her goggles... A blonde guy is standing in the middle of her lane. He winks at her.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I thought you could use some swimming company.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: How about next time, don't interrupt my practice, okay?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You got it...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Cameron.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm Cameron. Least known Spartan, but probably the best of the guys on the new boys' swimming team.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, at least you're humble about your swimming.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I've got nothing to be humble about.
Sara steps out of the pool, and starts toweling off.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm going to go. You're not supposed to mix swimming with an upset stomach.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Come on, you're leaving when we just met. At least give me your name...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: My name?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know you're totes done with the idea of running for President...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually, I don't know if I am...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Then, maybe I can help you decide. I want you to run for President so much, and the truth is... Me wanting that has never been about your popularity...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It hasn't?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I just thought it would be something we could do together, you know?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're friends with Spencer, you plan parties with Hector and the cool guys, you hang out with the nerds...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But we don't really have a thing, you know...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Aw, Jess... Why didn't you just tell me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I was going to but... I was... I was embarrassed to, like, need you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I just thought we could be a team. You could run, I could help you with your campaign, and then when you won, we could run things together!
Something triggers in Ben's mind... All around the restaurant, he sees the faces of the people he saved during the earthquake...
The moment ends.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben? You okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I... I don't think I'm going to run, Jess.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why not?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've... I've already done everything I can. Nothing's ever going to feel as good as it did when I saved everyone...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And that's it? You're sure? Even knowing that this is something I want you to do for me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... I understand if you don't want to be with me any...
Jessica stands up.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Bye, Ben. We're over.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?!
Jessica doesn't stick around to explain herself...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jess...
Want to see a happier conclusion to Ben's story? Try again and see if you can score enough points to unlock it!
In the meantime, let's check out the next candidate...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jess, I'm going to run for President!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: For reals?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... I think I finally figured out why I want to run...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why?
Out of the corner of Ben's eye, he sees Justin leaving...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll tell you later... Right now, I think I've got a big problem.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What is it?
Ben tells Jessica about his conversation with Justin.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So what do you think, Campaign Manager?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If he's going to fight dirty, then we will too!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't want to sink to his level, Jess.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben, remember how Justin tried to spend Sam's prize money so that the Spartans wouldn't get any of it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... That would have been a disaster.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If Justin wins, what's going to prevent the same thing from happening again? He can't see the big picture, Ben... Not the way you will...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're right, but I still don't like it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't worry, Ben... I'm not going to make you do something you don't want to do. I'm done with that. Leave the dirty stuff to me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... What are you going to do?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You'll see...
In the parking lot that night, Ben meets with Justin.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Is this your way of conceding the race before it even starts? If so, you could have just done it over the phone.
Ben hands Justin a manila folder.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What's this?
He opens it.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: These are personal letters I never sent to Angie! How did you get these?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Someone wanted me to use these against you... But I talked her out of it... I'm not going to use them.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I don't understand... Why give them to me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've decided to run for President, and I thought you should know my reason for running.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm not sure I care.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I want to make a difference.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What? That's...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Old-fashioned and lame? I know, but it's been pulling on me ever since the earthquake crisis...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I really loved helping people. And even though there isn't a life-threatening catastrophe happening every second, people still need help during the normal times.
Justin sighs...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I see you've made a couple of tough choices in the last few hours...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I have.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Then I guess... Thanks for choosing not to use the letters...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Did you read them?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Only enough to get the gist.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It's... It's only fair that I fight a clean campaign. Nothing dirty. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ditto.
They shake hands.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Besides, I think we've got our work cut out for us now.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You didn't hear? We're not the only ones running for President.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? Who else signed up?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I love you too, Ben!
Jessica gives Ben a big kiss.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I don't think any less of you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yay! That means `so` much to me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yay! That means [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much to me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why do I feel like I just avoided an important conversation?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, I think you've said enough.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I think we should talk about it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Fine. You're right, Ben. We should talk about it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I promise I won't be how I've been in the past...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So you're not going to be as demanding?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes what?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're really not going to let me out of this, are you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm telling you, the new Ben is not a push-over.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, then I kind of like the new Ben.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I promise I won't be as demanding.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good. And for the record, I've never thought any less of you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Awww...
Jessica leans over and kisses Ben. She whispers in his ear.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I love you, Ben. I mean it.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I love you too, Jess.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Consider yourself warned...
Justin leaves.
Ben turns around and sees Jessica watching him from a booth. He takes a deep breath, walks over, and sits down next to her.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Jess.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, Hero.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You want to have that talk now?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sure...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll start, if you don't mind...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Go ahead...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I told you during the earthquake crisis that I was done doing everything you wanted...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You said you were done `obeying` me.
nodes.text_bbcode: You said you were done [color=#3b78e2][i]obeying[/i][/color] me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That might not have been the right word, but I meant the gist of it... I'm my own man now.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay. Is that it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... I... I feel like things have been awkward between us because I wanted to save Denni, but... But you didn't seem nearly as concerned about her.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know, Ben. I've been thinking about that a lot lately, and it's not that I didn't care about her or anyone else for that matter... I really did... I just...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I didn't want to lose you, Ben. And I haven't felt that way about anyone. `Ever.` I'm sorry if that made you think any less of me...
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't want to lose you, Ben. And I haven't felt that way about anyone. [color=#3b78e2][i]Ever.[/i][/color] I'm sorry if that made you think any less of me...

options.label: Don't you have more to say about me being my own man?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're threatening me with something I'm proud of.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You are?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I am. What's wrong with making changes? What's wrong with improvement?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well... People... People think you've gone too far!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Let them think that. I'll just counter any smear campaign you come up with by saying that I believe in putting my best foot forward.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's what I've tried to do with my appearance, and that's what I'll try to do with the school...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hmph! Well, that's not the point anyway!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It isn't?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No! The point is... I will find `something` to use against you!
nodes.text_bbcode: No! The point is... I will find [color=#e23b3b][i]something[/i][/color] to use against you!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on, there's a reason you're still single!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm selective!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What about that shirt?! Is that supposed to be red? Look at `my` shirt! This is red!
nodes.text_bbcode: What about that shirt?! Is that supposed to be red? Look at [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] shirt! This is red!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: My family can't afford to just get me new clothes all the time, okay?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh... I'm sorry, Justin... I just got caught up...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No! That's okay! I don't need your pity...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I should have expected a personal attack from someone as superficial as you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I wish I hadn't said that...
Jessica walks away just as the guys reach Ben. Spencer pats him on the back!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You should have seen this guy during the earthquake! It was just like when Surf 'N' Turf Murph gave Tax Man Daniels the Eternal Steakdown!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I have no idea what you just said...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But oddly enough, I'm hungry.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think Spence is trying to say that Ben here was heroic...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Which is true! Ben, what you did really meant a lot to me and $ZOE! She's already baked over a hundred Ben-cakes in your honor.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was no problem...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And... Ben-cakes?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's just say I'm tired of eating your face...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Did `not` expect to hear that... Ever.
nodes.text_bbcode: Did [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] expect to hear that... Ever.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So are you going to run for President? You'd have my vote...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm... I'm not sure.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not sure? Do you know which girls would date you if you became President?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All of them! `Every` girl!
nodes.text_bbcode: All of them! [color=#e23b3b][i]Every[/i][/color] girl!

nodes.text: Hector points at girls as they walk by...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Her. Her. Definitely her. And her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... That last one was Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hi, Hecky!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, hey, Manda-Panda!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, my bad, not her. But you get my point!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I do, but I'm not really interested in dating a bunch of girls. I've already got Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She's... She's a girl, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think not running for office is the one thing about my high school time that I'm going to regret the most...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why would you regret that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I see the changes Justin's made for the school, and I wish I could have contributed something like that. Something that'll last even after I'm gone.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... Regret? After you're gone? You're...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm graduating this year.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, wow... It's hard to believe that's actually happening. Twin Branches is going to be so weird without you around.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm still trying to figure out just what schools I'm going to apply to! Centerscore University's nice, but I might actually be able to get into Kingston on a football scholarship!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Kingston? That's an Ivy League school on the East Coast! That'd be awesome!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know, but it would also mean leaving the city of Centerscore, leaving my family, and then there's $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh... Yeah...
The bell rings. As the guys head off to their classes, Spencer pulls Ben aside.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's this about you not running for President, Kale?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Eh... I keep thinking you were right about what you told me before the earthquake... That I was only running for President because I was obeying Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Good. You're not whipped anymore!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... Then again, I still have this strong urge to run, and I'm not sure why...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Am I still just doing what she wants? Or do `I` really want to run?
nodes.text_bbcode: Am I still just doing what she wants? Or do [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] really want to run?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale, you're too smart. You're all up in your head, man.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know! How do I get out?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I think the only thing you can do is talk to Jessica... And that means...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm really glad I'm not you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, thanks. I guess I'll talk with her at lunch today...
Later that day, Ben is in the line for lunch when Justin sidles up next to him...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Justin. Weird that we have to eat here while the cafeteria's under construction, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Look, I'm not here to make small talk, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: There's a rumor going around that you're planning on running for President.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not sure if I am.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Never mind. If you run, I'll have to bring everything I've got against you. And that includes airing your pandering attempts to gain popularity...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you talking about my parties?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm talking about the changes you've made to your appearance! There are even some rumors going around that you've gone `under the knife.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm talking about the changes you've made to your appearance! There are even some rumors going around that you've gone [color=#e23b3b][i]under the knife.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Plastic surgery? I'm not crazy!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, Justin, I `have` made changes to how I look. And yeah, I made those changes to improve my popularity.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, Justin, I [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] made changes to how I look. And yeah, I made those changes to improve my popularity.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: So you admit it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I do. I mean...

options.label: At least one of us cares about appearances.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Clearly now's not the time to talk about something this serious, but I promise... We'll talk about this later today.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay... Sure, Ben. I'll see you later.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: See you, Jess.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... If you're upset about me not running, we should probably talk about this now.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, I `really` want to talk about that while I'm `mad` at you... `In front of everyone!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] want to talk about that while I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]mad[/i][/color] at you... [color=#3b78e2][i]In front of everyone![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay... Now I'm thinking we probably shouldn't talk about this now...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You think?
In his seat near the front, Ben's brow furrows...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is there even a reason for me to run anymore? Or was it all just because Jessica wanted me to?
After class, Ben's hanging out near the other mobile classrooms when Jessica comes up to him, holding a copy of the school newspaper.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Hey, Jess.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, Hero!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That article in the paper came out about the earthquake! Not only did Nick take great pics of me and the girls, but you come across as, like, totes amazing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm so lucky to be your girlfriend... Now you're more popular than ever! You'll be President for sure!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I thought you'd be happier...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, Jess, we have to talk about what happened during the earthquake crisis at some point...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: About how both of us acted.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why don't we table that for now and just focus on getting you signed up for President?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I was actually just wondering if I should even `run` for President...
nodes.text_bbcode: I was actually just wondering if I should even [color=#e23b3b][i]run[/i][/color] for President...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `What?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The whole point was to achieve ultimate popularity, but I don't know if I can get any more popular. I mean, everyone thinks I'm a hero already!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But you `have` to be President, Ben!
nodes.text_bbcode: But you [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to be President, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why? Why does that seem so important to you?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because... I...
Just then, the popular guys see Ben from the other side of the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, guys! Check it out, it's Ben!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale! You the man!
Hector holds up the school paper, displaying a full page dedicated to Ben!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Boom! My boy Ben is `officially` too cool for school!
nodes.text_bbcode: Boom! My boy Ben is [color=#e23b3b][i]officially[/i][/color] too cool for school!

nodes.text: Ben turns back to Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Forget about it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... Jess, what were you going to say?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We'll talk about why I want you to run later...

options.label: Promise to talk with Jess later.
Insist on talking about it now.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You really brought it today, Ms. Lee. New haircut? New earrings? New shade of lipstick?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: No... All the same old style!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It must be something else then!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Maybe it's this new girdle I've been trying...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Too much info again, Ms. Lee.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, I tell you what... Since you're a nice person, I'm sure no one will mind...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I hereby declare you, whatever your name is, to be school President!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks, Ms. Lee! You're the best!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I know...
Want to see the conclusion of Taylor's story? Try again and see if you can score enough points to unlock it!
In the meantime, let's see how you did!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I admit, I'm a little disappointed that I had to spell that out for you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I always thought you'd be the one to figure it out. Guess I was wrong...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're not going to get away with it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I think I'm going to be sick...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This `is` the place for it.
nodes.text_bbcode: This [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] the place for it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I am not using Ben! Ben `wants` to become President! He'll actually make a good one!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am not using Ben! Ben [color=#3b78e2][i]wants[/i][/color] to become President! He'll actually make a good one!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And we like each other, whether you believe it or not!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Then what am I missing?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hahaha! Seriously? Do I have to spell it out for you?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Who was dating Ben before I swooped in?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You didn't?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I might have played a small part in Ben's break-up with Denni, but let's face it, they were never going to last!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: My finest work.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I did some pretty manipulative things in my day, Jessica, but this... This is way ugly.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugly? Or beautiful?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You wanted to regain all the privileges of being the First Lady!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wouldn't you? Shopping sprees! Red carpet events! Schmoozing!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! That means...

options.label: You broke up Ben and Denni!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh... Gross! You think `I` want all that responsibility!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Gross! You think [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] want all that responsibility!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why do all the work when you can have all the perks?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! You didn't want to become President... You wanted to date the next one!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Duh, yeah!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm impressed, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The feeling isn't mutual!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Very good!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You knew that once you got rid of me, the other cheerleaders would nominate $ZOE for Head Cheerleader... So you made her take the fall for leaking that video tape!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Two birds, one stone! I never really got that expression 'til then!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You couldn't imagine someone as low as Justin breaking up with you, but he did. And you lost all your First Lady privileges...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, well, who knew `Justin` had a conscience?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, who knew [color=#3b78e2][i]Justin[/i][/color] had a conscience?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There was no way Justin would ever take you back... So you devised a new strategy... You decided to...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I saw an opportunity, and I struck!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! There's more, isn't there?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Awww, I'm disappointed. I think you're getting a little ahead of yourself...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Using $ZOE didn't get me any power... Overthrowing you as Head Cheerleader did!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How could you?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It was easy! And super fun!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait... That's not all... There's more isn't there?
He hands her a tissue.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Come on, let's forget about this and see if we can get Erik's giant some gold...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh yeah, what are we going to do about his donkey not being magical?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Heh. Anything can happen... Maybe it `will` start laying golden eggs!
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. Anything can happen... Maybe it [color=#e23b3b][i]will[/i][/color] start laying golden eggs!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll be right there, I'm just going to go clean myself up...
Taylor steps into the girls' restroom...
And finds Jessica there, standing in front of one of the mirrors.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How are all your geeky friends doing? You having fun playing dolls?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm having a lot of fun. Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, no problem. I know you're not going to ask me about what I've been up to... For obvious reasons... So I'll just share!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I've been to some totes awesome parties... Some of them thrown by my boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You might know him... He's Ben, the most popular guy in school. Here's an article about him being a hero in the paper if you want to learn more about him.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know who Ben is.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Great! Then you also know that he'll be President soon!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So I've heard...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Of course, you probably also know that as First Lady, I'll be requiring a lot of Audio / Visual assistance from your friends...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I hear that your boyfriend is surprisingly good at physical combat, so I'm thinking of enlisting him as my personal bodyguard.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That means he'll have to be around me all the time, looking after me, protecting me, you know, watching my every move.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You wouldn't!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Please! It's pretty much already done! Don't think I don't still remember all the crap you put me through when you were Head Cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait... This whole thing... It's all been...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yes?
The gears in Taylor's head start spinning wildly, connections are formed, suddenly a disturbing pattern reveals itself to her...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I can't believe it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Can't believe what?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: A long time ago... You... You were dating Justin and that made you First Lady.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Go on...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...But you wanted more power, so you...

nodes.text: I don't throw super awesome parties! I don't even go to them anymore!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't make myself over... Look at me, I've got cheese puff residue on my skirt!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't even save people from collapsing buildings!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... That does require timing and...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If he's so much better, Brendan, why don't you just date him?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whoa! Where is this coming from?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm upset, okay?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, you're making `me` upset too!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you're making [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] upset too!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Supporting Ben has `nothing` to do with who we like better! He's just a better candidate!
nodes.text_bbcode: Supporting Ben has [color=#e23b3b][i]nothing[/i][/color] to do with who we like better! He's just a better candidate!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry...
Brendan sighs.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Here you go.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He's done a lot to improve his rep...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He started dating Jessica, he's thrown epic parties, he's changed his look... Twice!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And he definitely proved he could lead during the earthquake crisis.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Maybe you should be dating `him...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe you should be dating [color=#e23b3b][i]him...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't know about that! My guy has his own merits.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I believe you're referring to my inexhaustible wit and charm.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And you have a nice smile.
Brendan smiles widely for Taylor.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm glad you followed me out here...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Here you go.

nodes.text: So before you sign up, ask yourself... Why should `I` run?
nodes.text_bbcode: So before you sign up, ask yourself... Why should [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] run?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Erik's so great when he's all serious like this!
After class, Taylor and the nerds are setting up the map for Ogres 'N' Elves...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Guys, my giant is just twenty thousand gold pieces away from opening his inn!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: How much gold does he have already?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well... None. He blew it all on that magic donkey at the market!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `Magic` donkey? I don't think the donkey is actually...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Magic[/i][/color] donkey? I don't think the donkey is actually...

nodes.text: Taylor steps on Brendan's toe.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `Ow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ow![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I mean... Solid purchase, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can't wait till Mr. Hee-Haw lays his first golden egg. I'll give him an extra carrot treat for sure!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, hey Erik! Nice job on the announcements this morning.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm just excited that our group finally has someone `popular` who can run for President. Someone who can really represent us!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm just excited that our group finally has someone [color=#3b78e2][i]popular[/i][/color] who can run for President. Someone who can really represent us!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: President?! Do the nerds think that `I'm` going to run for...?
nodes.text_bbcode: President?! Do the nerds think that [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] going to run for...?

nodes.text: Dex raises his soda can above his head! The nerds follow suit...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: A toast! To the most popular nerd!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, I don't know about...
All the nerds chime in at the same time...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: To Ben!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: To Ben!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: To Ben!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Ben?` But he's...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ben?[/i][/color] But he's...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! Ben `is` more popular than I am!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ohmygosh! Ben [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] more popular than I am!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's happened to me?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Are you okay, Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh-huh! I was just... Um, start without me!
A few seconds later... Taylor bursts out of the school. She takes deep breaths, trying to stave off tears.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm... I'm not the queen of this school any more... Am I?
A gentle hand grabs hers and she turns to see...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, you okay?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah... I'm fine... I think.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I just wasn't expecting Ben to be the person you guys rallied around.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I thought it was going to be me.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Awww... You understand why it's him, though, right?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah... I get it...

nodes.text: Thin ice, Mr. Warren...

nodes.text: I know, but hear me out...

nodes.text: The school just got three hundred bros from Spartan Academy, including yours truly.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If you want to stop the student body from fighting, bring in some girls!

nodes.text: That was a risky answer, but a well-thought out idea! Really risky...

nodes.text: I'm a risky guy.

nodes.text: I'll accept your application... Don't make me regret it!
Score Up!

nodes.text: So... You're saying I'm a politician?

nodes.text: I'm saying you picked something up, but I'm not convinced yet. Can you tell me why smaller class sizes are so important?

nodes.text: Uh, well, if the class is large then, um, the teacher's voice will echo more.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And that will make it harder for the students to hear.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Smaller class sizes, better hearing.
Shapiro shakes her head...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh... Well, that could be helpful too.

nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. Leave an application with me, and I'll [color=#3b78e2][i]consider[/i][/color] you. Against all my natural instincts.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I `am` serious, Principal... Uh, Shrapnel.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] serious, Principal... Uh, Shrapnel.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Just get out of my office, Mr. Warren.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes ma'am.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh... Like I was saying, Ms. Lee, you look good, you know, for an old lady.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Old?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wrong word. I didn't mean to say old. Let me try again...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What I meant to say was... Your ears... They are... Weird?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: How dare you! There's no way someone like you should `ever` be President!
nodes.text_bbcode: How dare you! There's no way someone like you should [color=#3b78e2][i]ever[/i][/color] be President!

nodes.text: Wonderful let me get you a sign up sheet!

nodes.text: No no! No sign up sheet for me! I wish to be President now!

nodes.text: Uh... What else do you think leaders are like?

nodes.text: Finally!

nodes.text: Anyway... I'll come with you to Ms. Lee's to sign up...

nodes.speaker: Colt

nodes.text: Uh... What? It's not going to be that easy...

nodes.text: Your name is `not` a verb.
nodes.text_bbcode: Your name is [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] a verb.

nodes.text: Nearby, Ryan holds up his History test to the rebels...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Check it out! I got an A! And all I did was cheat off of the nerd next to me! I really Colted it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Exhibit A, Princess.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Fine... But `Colting it` negates the whole point of being responsible and growing up...
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine... But [color=#3b78e2][i]Colting it[/i][/color] negates the whole point of being responsible and growing up...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Relax, I'm not going to do anything grown-ups don't already do...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Unfortunately, that statement does not bring me a whole lot of comfort...
A few minutes later, Colt steps into Ms. Lee's temporary office...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Just the young man I wanted to see...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Am I in trouble?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You? Heavens, no! From what I know about you, you couldn't find trouble if it slapped you in the face and told you its name!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Are you sure you're not mistaking me for someone else?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I could be. It wouldn't be the first time. But don't tell me your name. Let's keep the mystery!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Right. I'm here to become the President.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Lovely! Let me get you a sign up sheet!
As Ms. Lee rifles through a stack of papers that appear to be blank, Colt clears his throat.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're looking nice today, Ms. Lee!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh! Thank you! I haven't heard a compliment in so long!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: All my ex-husband's compliments came in grunts and belches!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Way `way` too much info, Ms. Lee.
nodes.text_bbcode: Way [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too much info, Ms. Lee.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Listen... I'd really like to bypass this whole sign up process and just be declared President. You can do that, right?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hmmm... Time to turn on my charm!

options: That lipstick is a nice shade!
Your eyes are like a bug's!
You look good for an old lady!
nodes.title: Make your choice!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What you said was right, Princess! I need to start thinking about my future...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And just like that, you're suddenly interested in changing?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well that's what you've been talking about, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It feels like you're just telling me what you think I want you to say...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: When really, I want you to tell me what `you` want to say. The truth, Colt.
nodes.text_bbcode: When really, I want you to tell me what [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] want to say. The truth, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay. The truth... I have no idea what you just said.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Man, I can't win!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why can't you just tell me that the only reason you're suddenly interested in the Presidency is because I put pressure on you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Because that's a classic girl trap!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's not a girl trap!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Fine!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Fine!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait, it's not a trap?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No... It's okay for you to do something because I want you to. If you hadn't lied, it would have actually been sweet.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Reverse girl trap.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're seriously going to run for President... Just because I asked you to start thinking about your future?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, I mean, I think it's a waste of time but when it comes to anything related to my future, I'm going to take your advice.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm impressed... And kind of flattered.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You should be. I don't follow the advice of any of my other girlfriends.
Denni elbows Colt in the ribs.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Very funny.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Besides, how hard can it be to beat that Justin kid? No one likes him anyway. I'm a lock.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: All right, rein in that ego, you haven't even registered yet.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: When I win, do we get to live in a big white house together?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So before you sign up, ask yourself... Why should `I` run?
nodes.text_bbcode: So before you sign up, ask yourself... Why should [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] run?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Pfft! How about who cares?
After class, Colt helps Denni walk to her next class.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How's the leg, Princess?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Perfect. I'm finally getting used to my crutches.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I like seeing you like this. You know, not in a hospital bed.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You mean, mobile?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, and alive.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I should thank Tweed again the next time I see his moppy head...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I overheard him and Howard talking about colleges. You know Howard's graduating?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's crazy. Howard graduating is like the sun exploding or something. It just doesn't happen.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You know what does happen? The future.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aaaaaaand... Here comes the lecture.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: If you're ever going to get into college, Colt, you're going to have to turn your grades around and start, you know, participating.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: College? Don't get ahead of yourself, Princess. I'm not graduating anytime soon.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But you `will,` Colt.
nodes.text_bbcode: But you [color=#3b78e2][i]will,[/i][/color] Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'll figure something out.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Just so you know, you can't sneak your way into college. A shady moustache and a Domingo Florentine ID probably aren't going to fly.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Har har. Look, college isn't for me, okay? Can you imagine `me` cramming for an exam, declaring a major, or pledging in a fraternity?
nodes.text_bbcode: Har har. Look, college isn't for me, okay? Can you imagine [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] cramming for an exam, declaring a major, or pledging in a fraternity?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I already did that Greek thing with the Spartans and look how `it` turned out!
nodes.text_bbcode: I already did that Greek thing with the Spartans and look how [color=#e23b3b][i]it[/i][/color] turned out!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, well, I'd be really surprised if you end up in `another` corruption turned motorcycle versus helicopter, fiery explosion scenario.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, well, I'd be really surprised if you end up in [color=#3b78e2][i]another[/i][/color] corruption turned motorcycle versus helicopter, fiery explosion scenario.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heh. Words.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Just tell me you'll think about it, okay?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah yeah.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm serious, Colt!
Denni stops walking and stares at Colt.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't want either of us to coast along and then somewhere down the line realize that we could have done something with our lives if only we had started now!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay okay... I get it. Breathe, Tiny Hipster.
At that moment, Justin rushes past them...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Out of the way!
Colt smiles.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Another brilliant idea from `The Coltster!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Another brilliant idea from [color=#e23b3b][i]The Coltster![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh-oh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'll be school President!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I think 'The Coltster' needs his ego checked...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You just said I need to start participating. What's more participate-y than running for office?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, I do think you need to participate more... Like actually going to class or doing your homework! Small things, Colt...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Like learning the Principal's name...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shrapnel?
Denni sighs.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why would you possibly run for President?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know... I guess I'd run...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Another successful Colting! I knew I'd be President!
Ten minutes later, Colt gets called into Principal Shapiro's temporary office.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You wanted to see me?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: `Want` is a funny word, Mr. Warren. Louisa tells me she already declared you President, completely circumventing our established election process.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Want[/i][/color] is a funny word, Mr. Warren. Louisa tells me she already declared you President, completely circumventing our established election process.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Pretty cool of her, right?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: No. Not cool at all!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: You cannot `Colt` this one.
nodes.text_bbcode: You cannot [color=#3b78e2][i]Colt[/i][/color] this one.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa! You know about Colting?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: You'd be a fool to think I'm not keeping watch over my students, Mr. Warren.
Principal Shapiro looks out the window...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And lately, the students seem to be concerned only with fighting...
She turns her attention back to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Ms. Lee has her faults, but she would do `anything` for her students. You `will` apologize for taking advantage of her.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ms. Lee has her faults, but she would do [color=#3b78e2][i]anything[/i][/color] for her students. You [color=#3b78e2][i]will[/i][/color] apologize for taking advantage of her.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Additionally, you will drop out of the race for Presidency.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `What?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]What?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: There are too many kids who want to run for office who take this seriously! I won't have you messing up their chances because of some lark of yours!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait... I `want` to run for President. Seriously.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... I [color=#e23b3b][i]want[/i][/color] to run for President. Seriously.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Does this have something to do with your recent friendship with Miss Fallon?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Being President to impress a girl doesn't count as taking this seriously.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know, I know. But it isn't about impressing her...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She thinks I should think about going to college, and I think she's right... And that's a lot of thinking for me.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm listening...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm not going to be able to get in with my grades... But if I have something extra, something big like President, I might actually turn some heads at the office of admissions.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Maybe I had you pegged wrong... All right, I'll let you run, but on one condition.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shoot.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Tell me one thing you'd change about this school to make it better...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh...
It looks like you didn't quite do well enough to see the end of everyone's story!

Let's tally your score!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I... I don't think I'm going to run, Jess.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why not?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've... I've already done everything I can. Nothing's ever going to feel as good as it did when I saved everyone...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And that's it? You're sure? Even knowing that this is something I want you to do for me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... I understand if you don't want to be with me any...
Jessica stands up.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Bye, Ben. We're over.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?!
Jessica doesn't stick around to explain herself...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jess...
Want to see a happier conclusion to Ben's story? Try again and see if you can score enough points to unlock it!
In the meantime, let's check out the next candidate...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Emily loves me so much, she'll follow in my footsteps, whatever I do...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But I'm a swimmer... That's what I do... And that's what she'll do...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: In fact, that's what I'm going to do now... Might as well...
Later that night, Sara sneaks into the pool and swims laps, the water cold and uninviting...
She tries not to think about what it will mean to swim and only swim for the rest of her life...
But the more she tries, the more it becomes evident to her...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm `alone...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]alone...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Want to see a happier ending to Sara's story? Try again and see if you can score enough points to unlock it!
In the meantime, let's check out the next candidate...
Later that week...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt! They just announced the candidates for President! You said you signed up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shrapnel must have rejected me...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I guess we'll have to find another way to make you attractive for college.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You saying I'm ugly, Princess?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No. I'm saying we need to...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know. That's enough, Tiny Hipster. I don't need to go to college.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What? You're sure?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm sure...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What about when `I` go to college...
nodes.text_bbcode: What about when [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] go to college...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's not happening anytime soon.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But it will happen...
Want to see a happier conclusion to Colt's story? Try again and see if you can score enough points to unlock it!
In the meantime, let's check out the next candidate...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jess, I'm going to run for President!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: For reals?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... I think I finally figured out why I want to run...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why?
Out of the corner of Ben's eye, he sees Justin leaving...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll tell you later... Right now, I think I've got a big problem.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What is it?
Ben tells Jessica about his conversation with Justin.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So what do you think, Campaign Manager?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If he's going to fight dirty, then we will too!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't want to sink to his level, Jess.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben, remember how Justin tried to spend Sam's prize money so that the Spartans wouldn't get any of it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... That would have been a disaster.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If Justin wins, what's going to prevent the same thing from happening again? He can't see the big picture, Ben... Not the way you will...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're right, but I still don't like it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't worry, Ben... I'm not going to make you do something you don't want to do. I'm done with that. Leave the dirty stuff to me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... What are you going to do?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You'll see...
In the parking lot that night, Ben meets with Justin.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Is this your way of conceding the race before it even starts? If so, you could have just done it over the phone.
Ben hands Justin a manila folder.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What's this?
He opens it.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: These are personal letters I never sent to Angie! How did you get these?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Someone wanted me to use these against you... But I talked her out of it... I'm not going to use them.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I don't understand... Why give them to me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've decided to run for President, and I thought you should know my reason for running.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm not sure I care.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I want to make a difference.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What? That's...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Old-fashioned and lame? I know, but it's been pulling on me ever since the earthquake crisis...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I really loved helping people. And even though there isn't a life-threatening catastrophe happening every second, people still need help during the normal times.
Justin sighs...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I see you've made a couple of tough choices in the last few hours...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I have.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Then I guess... Thanks for choosing not to use the letters...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Did you read them?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Only enough to get the gist.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It's... It's only fair that I fight a clean campaign. Nothing dirty. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ditto.
They shake hands.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Besides, I think we've got our work cut out for us now.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You didn't hear? We're not the only ones running for President.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? Who else signed up?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Emily loves me so much, she'll follow in my footsteps, whatever I do...
The next day, Sara is heading toward Ms. Lee's temporary office when she runs into Nick.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hey, Nick! I was just going to sign up to run for President!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Taking my advice? I'm surprised considering how dumb we guys are...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Actually, my motivation came from home.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: From your dad? Isn't he kind of... Not encouraging?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: To put it mildly. It came from my younger sister.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I didn't know you had a sister...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, she's growing up, and I thought I'd try to be a better role model for her.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I guess we can add that to the list of Kessler verbs: Swimming, eating, and now, role-modeling.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hee hee! Very funny.
Nick reaches into his backpack, and pulls out a stack of glossy pictures.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I was planning on using these to convince you to run...
He hands them to her. Each one has a picture of Sara swimming, the entire image laid out perfectly.
Stylized text says, 'Vote for Sara. She's a Kessler. And that means, she cares about what she does.'

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: These are amazing!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't know if you've thought about this yet, since you've only just decided to run, but...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Do you want me to be your campaign manager?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, I like you.
Sara can't help but blush.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I mean, not like that. What I meant was...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I like you... Others will too.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Awww... I would really like it if you were my campaign manager, Nick.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: We'll be the Outsider Party.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Great! Because I just found out who else is running, and I think you'll need all the help you can get!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Wait... Who else is running?!
That night, Colt climbs in through Denni's window.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So, am I dating the new school President?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I wish.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What? I'm so shocked! You weren't able to convince the universe that 'The Coltster' should just `be` President, no work required?
nodes.text_bbcode: What? I'm so shocked! You weren't able to convince the universe that 'The Coltster' should just [color=#3b78e2][i]be[/i][/color] President, no work required?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, I'm wounded already, Princess. I don't need you to twist the knife any more than it's already twisted.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm sorry. What happened?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I got hit by some shrapnel, that's what.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Shapiro?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, she's a tough cookie. It looks like I'm going to have to run for President the normal way.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That means campaign posters, slogans, a lame speech. Blech. So much work.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This way sucks.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, sometimes you just have to `Denni` it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, sometimes you just have to [color=#3b78e2][i]Denni[/i][/color] it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is that what the normal way's called?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yup. And luckily, you've got me to help you through it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait a second, maybe I don't want you as my manager. How good are you at `Denni-ing?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a second, maybe I don't want you as my manager. How good are you at [color=#e23b3b][i]Denni-ing?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The best. This way `is` named after me, after all.
nodes.text_bbcode: The best. This way [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] named after me, after all.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heh. You're hired.
Colt takes Denni's hand. She looks up at him.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, uh... Do you think I can really do it?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The normal way? It's not `that` hard, Colt.
nodes.text_bbcode: The normal way? It's not [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] hard, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, I mean... Do you think I could go to college?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: If you tried, Colt, I think you could probably do just about anything.
Colt looks deeply into Denni's eyes.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's just... No one's ever gone to college in my family...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No one's ever even mentioned college to me...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're the first, Princess.
He leans down and kisses her.
After a long time, they part.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why are you smiling so much?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I just realized that with you helping me out, I can't lose!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That might have been true if you were just running against Justin...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, which nerd can compete against me?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You didn't hear?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Who is it? Who else is running?
Congratulations! You played a great game, and got to meet four of the candidates!
Let's tally your score!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: It was nice to meet you, Sara.
Sara makes a disgusted face as she leaves.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Why are guys such idiots?
After getting changed, Sara runs into Nick on the school's front yard...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh, hey, Sara. Have you seen Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No, she usually leaves with the other girls.
